prompt:
Use case: neutral educational photorealistic visual learning asset for the Hanzi 足; subject ID foot only.
Primary request: one vertical 1024x1792 photographic triptych containing exactly three independent horizontal landscape photographs stacked top to bottom, separated by two narrow straight white horizontal seams approximately 8 pixels thick near y=597 and y=1195. No outer border.
Subject: one ordinary healthy adult human foot, depicted using wholly synthetic AI imagery with no real identity. The adult is fully clothed in a plain shirt and loose neutral trousers; only the bare foot and a small ankle area are exposed for a neutral body-part lesson. No other person or identifying details.
Top photograph: the top of the foot, viewed from above while it rests naturally on a clean pale floor or examination mat, clearly showing the dorsum, five toes and toenails. Include the complete heel-to-toe foot silhouette and a little trouser cuff.
Middle photograph: the sole of the same adult foot, facing the camera in a comfortable supported seated position. Show the complete heel, arch, ball and five toe pads without distortion. The trouser-covered lower leg recedes naturally into an unobtrusive background; no hands touching the foot.
Bottom photograph: a clear side view of the same adult foot resting naturally on the clean mat, showing its heel, arch profile, toes and ankle below the trouser cuff. The whole foot fits in the panel.
Composition/framing: three standalone wide landscape photographs in exact top-of-foot, sole, side order. Keep the entire foot centered with at least 10 percent safe margins on every side, anatomically plausible proportions and exactly five toes. Calm pale uncluttered clinical or educational backdrop; no dramatic posing or emphasis beyond ordinary anatomy.
Style/medium: authentic photorealistic synthetic educational photography, natural skin texture and creases, normal toenails, gentle daylight, believable shadows and neutral colors. Not a plastic foot model, drawing or cartoon.
Constraints: fully clothed adult apart from the educationally exposed foot and ankle; no real identities, permission claims, nudity, sexualized or fetish framing, injuries, disease, blood or gore. Exactly three panels and two white seams. No writing, text, labels, letters, numbers, logos, watermark or decorative graphics.
reviewNotes: Inspected only the 300x525 JPEG preview. Top shows the dorsum and toes of an adult foot below a gray trouser cuff; middle shows the sole facing the camera in a seated pose with clothed leg; bottom shows the foot side profile on a pale floor. Neutral educational framing, visible skin creases and ordinary toenails; no visible injury, gore, sexualized styling or identifying context. Torso clothing and fine anatomical detail cannot be verified because they are outside the preview framing or too small. Middle sole has small top and bottom margins, less than requested 10 percent, but heel and toes appear intact for the 8-pixel crop inset. Top ankle/trouser cuff intentionally enters from the left. No visible writing or watermark. Sharp measured white seam rows 566–576 and 1215–1225 in the 1024x1792 source; centers 571 and 1220. Panels are not equal height.
